title: Fixed Open Cross-Frame Dish Rack
description: One original complete fixed-open cross-frame wooden dish-rack appearance. Two width-offset pairs of full diagonal end rails form actual X silhouettes and connect through transverse pins. A high rear slatted deck and lower opposing front slatted deck form an open V cradle with real gaps between every full-width wooden slat; four short foot pads meet the ground. Entire new whole numeric geometry, not the old catch-tray/vertical-loop rack or the flat-centre/outward-wing laundry rack resized. Three opaque constant PBR materials, no dishes, water, catch tray or textures. One whole prop, zero scenes. Only the displayed static pose: no folding sweep, actual hinge mechanics, drainage simulation, plate compatibility/capacity, load, food hygiene, manufacture, stability or safety certification.
